changes.comment: The daemon now rejects a built-in command that it never serves, such as `rush list`, before the request waits for admission, so that the client runs it in-process at once. Before, such a request could wait behind a build that waited for the running build before it reloaded the graph, and fail when its own wait timeout ran out. A custom command still waits for admission, because only its parse can tell whether the daemon serves it. As before, the daemon first stops the work that finished requests continue, unless the command only reads the workspace, and answers with the restart result instead once its installation changed.
